dial.summary: October ISM Manufacturing PMI beat at 55.5 (vs 54.5 prior, 10th consecutive expansion month) upgrades macro momentum from neutral to supportive; real yields fell another 3bps to 2.60% on Oct 30 TIPS data, continuing the -30bps October decline; DXY softened to ~101.54 ahead of US midterms, still a headwind but losing conviction; 5 of 8 indicators now supportive, BTC.D holding ~58-60% with no alt-rotation signal — BTC Accumulation posture intact on improving macro and reset funding rates post-Oct 30 capitulation.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 aggregate (US/Euro Zone/China/Japan) remains at ~$104.3T as of September 2026 (104,317B vs 103,624B in August); October 2026 data not yet available — MacroMicro typically updates mid-month following the reference month; US M2 at $23.41T in Sep 2026 (+5.7% YoY) confirms no YoY contraction; 4-week Aug→Sep change +$0.64T (+0.6%) exceeds the 0.5% flat threshold — trend remains UP; status supportive (4-week trend up); next G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI printed 55.5% (released November 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET), beating consensus of 54.6% and up 1.0pp from September's 54.5%; 10th consecutive month of expansion; Production sub-index surged to 59.0 (highest since November 2021), New Orders at 55.5; Prices remained elevated at 75.2 (9th straight reading above 70); 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); status upgraded to supportive (above 50 and rising); ISM chair cited Iran war and price volatility as the primary sentiment drag despite broad expansion.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot ~101.54 on November 3, 2026 (FXEmpire, ahead of US midterms); Nov 2 close ~101.53 (Trading Economics); prior run Nov 2 value was 101.93; 4-week trend FLAT — dollar drifted ~0.37% lower over the prior month, within the 0.5% flat threshold; 52-week high was 102.95 on October 14, 2026; softening ahead of midterms on EUR/USD and GBP/USD strength but no sustained reversal; DXY remains above the 100 headwind threshold; status headwind (above 100 threshold).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.60% as of October 30, 2026 (FRED DFII10, next update November 3); recent readings: Oct 29 = 2.63%, Oct 28 = 2.67%, Oct 27 = 2.64%, Oct 26 = 2.66%; 4-week trend DOWN — from ~2.93% on September 29 to 2.60% on October 30, -33bps over the month, deepening the October improvement; status supportive per rules (falling trend); absolute level at 2.60% remains restrictive but directional improvement is clear heading into the December 8-9 FOMC.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: November 3, 2026: 10Y ~4.906%, 2Y ~4.564%, spread ~+32bps (247wallst: curve flattened 6bps on Nov 3; CNBC Nov 2: 10Y 4.906%, 2Y 4.594%, spread ~31bps); 4-week trend DOWN — from ~+42bps on October 1 to ~+32bps on November 3, -10bps flattening; curve is positive (well above the -50bps headwind threshold) but continues to flatten as 2Y yields hold sticky on Dec 9 FOMC hike expectations while 10Y dips; status neutral (positive but flattening, not steepening).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL weekly data (H.4.1 released October 29, 2026): Sep 30 $6,743,031M → Oct 7 $6,747,560M → Oct 14 $6,755,639M → Oct 21 $6,753,604M → Oct 28 $6,745,635M ($6.75T); 4-week change Sep 30 to Oct 28 = +$2.6B ≈ 0%, flat; balance sheet oscillating in a narrow ~$12B band around $6.75T; next H.4.1 release November 5, 2026 (covering week ending Nov 5); status supportive (flat post-QT-pause stabilization; no aggressive QT, overnight rates stable).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: Last reliable snapshot ~0.0087% per 8h OI-weighted (DeFiRate, ~Oct 23); post-October 30 crash ($1.49B liquidations, 86.8% longs flushed) likely compressed funding toward zero or negative — DeFiRate 30-day average cited at ~5.3% annualized, down from mid-October highs; MacroMicro showed 0.0067% on Sep 30 as context for the trend direction; 30-day trend DOWN (declining from pre-crash elevated levels through post-crash reset); status supportive (near zero, well below 0.04% headwind threshold); CoinGlass live data unavailable in this session — value held at last reliable snapshot.

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$301-303B (Stablecoin Beat $301.3B; CoinGecko ~$303B); total crypto market cap ~$2.6-2.67T (CoinGecko $2.67T, CoinMarketCap $2.57T); implied stablecoin dominance ~11.6% (down from 11.9% prior run as crypto market cap partially recovered post-Oct 30 crash); 30-day trend UP (Oct 3 ~10.5% → Nov 3 ~11.6%, +1.1pp); rising dominance primarily driven by TOTAL market cap compression post-crash and ongoing BTC.D concentration; status neutral — headwind condition requires rising stablecoin dom AND rising TOTAL simultaneously; TOTAL remains below pre-crash levels.
